knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The standard expects staff not to attend work with an acute, probably infectious illness and asks them to follow the facility's illness policy.
Timely reporting and follow-up are part of the facility's post-exposure route, so the injury is reported at once.
The standard ties the recommendation to how likely the worker is to contact patients and bodily fluids.

practicalCriteria: Learner states the illness signs that require staying away from patient areas, with at least three correct
Learner walks through the post-exposure reporting steps in order on a scenario card
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Assessor record of the scenario walkthrough
stopWorkCriteria: Worker presents with an acute probable infection
Exposure to bodily fluid with no reporting route available
